title: eragrostis mendocina
intro: Eragrostis mendocina, commonly known as grass of the Andes or Queñua grass, is a type of grass native to the Andean highlands. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion, showcasing its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Eragrostis mendocina include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
